biggest_catch: You only earn for the specific products the friend actually completes - $25 for checking with $500+ direct deposit, another $25 for 20+ debit purchases, another $50 for a $10,000+ loan - so a bare account opening earns you nothing.
catches: Referrer earns only for products the referred member completes within 60 days of membership: $25 for checking + $500+ qualifying direct deposits, +$25 for 20+ debit card purchases, +$50 for a new loan of $10,000+.
The new member must notify the PAFCU employee of the referrer's name at account opening - without it, no bonus.
New member receives the same benefits for completed products (symmetric payout).
Referral rewards paid on the second day of the month following the member's 60th day (e.g., ~2 months after joining).
No referral-count cap stated on the page.

steps: Tell friends to name you as referrer when they open a PAFCU membership.
Friend establishes membership and, within 60 days, completes any of: checking with $500+ direct deposits ($25 to you), 20+ debit purchases (+$25), $10,000+ new loan (+$50).
Referral rewards are paid on the second day of the month after the friend's 60th day as a member.
timing: Rewards paid on the second day of the month following the referred member's 60th day.
when_cash_arrives: Rewards paid on the second day of the month following the referred member's 60th day. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
